digest.heading: Since yesterday
digest.quiet: Nothing happened overnight. Nothing is waiting on you.

meetings.heading: Meetings
meetings.intro: It listens and takes notes. It cannot speak in a meeting, and everyone in the room is asked before it connects.
meetings.listening: Listening to this meeting and taking notes. It cannot speak.
meetings.insightsQuiet: Nothing worth interrupting you for yet.
meetings.insightsNone: Nothing was flagged during this meeting.
meetings.enable: Let it join and take notes in my meetings
meetings.enableHint: Off unless you turn it on. Everyone in a meeting is asked before it connects, and it can never speak.
meetings.meetingsAreCappedSoACall: Meetings are capped so a call nobody closed cannot keep recording all day. Another 30 minutes uses about 30 more minutes of your meeting allowance.
meetings.nothingHasBeenDoneAboutThis: Nothing has been done about this.

documents.heading: Your documents
documents.intro: Anything you add here, it can read and cite. Nothing is used to train anything, and deleting a document removes what it learned from it.
documents.types: PDF, text, Markdown — or a photo of a page
documents.none: No documents yet. Add a contract, a spec or a policy and ask about it.
documents.reading: Reading {{name}}. A long document takes a minute; a photo is quicker.

voice.heading: Spoken conversations
voice.keep: Keep a record of what is said
voice.keepHint: Off by default. When on, both what you say and what it replies are saved to that conversation — useful for reviews and audits. You can delete any conversation's record afterwards.

share.heading: Share
share.hint: Shared with the person, not with a link. They can read this one artifact — never the documents behind it — and you can take it back at any time.
share.nothingYetWhenSomeoneSharesA: Nothing yet. When someone shares a document with you, it appears here.

language.heading: Language
language.hint: The language of this interface. It does not change the language you speak to it in — that follows you.

common.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Nothing changed — try again.
common.everyAgentThisSystemWillTalk: Every agent this system will talk to, with its published contract checked at the moment you asked — not when it was deployed.
common.nothingHereIsAttestedIncludingThe: Nothing here is attested, including the address it advertises.
common.builtFromWhatYouActuallyDid: Built from what you actually did and corrected — not from a form you filled in once. Every entry says what changed and why, and you can put any of it back.
common.everythingYouAndTheCompanionAre: Everything you and the companion are working through.
common.standingInstructionsThatRunWithout: Standing instructions that run without you. Every run lands in the same plan and the same trace as a session you drove yourself.
common.irreversibleActionsExternalSendsPa: Irreversible actions — external sends, payments, deletions — always stop and ask, whatever a watcher’s ceiling is set to. That floor is not yours to lower.
common.allthewayCouldNotReachTheNetwork: AllTheWay could not reach the network. Your sessions are safe — reconnect and this page will pick up where it left off.

canvas.askForADraftInThe: Ask for a draft in the conversation and it will appear here, where you can correct it.
canvas.generatedByAllthewayThisFileCarrie: Generated by AllTheWay. This file carries content credentials identifying it as AI-generated, and they survive download.
canvas.anythingItDraftsForYouLands: Anything it drafts for you lands here — a document, a summary, a wireframe — with every version you corrected, and a way to take it with you.

comments.youHaveViewOnlyAccessTo: You have view-only access to this.

connections.whatAllthewayIsAllowedToReach: What AllTheWay is allowed to reach on your behalf. It still asks before it does anything that cannot be undone.
connections.draftingIsTheSafestThingIt: Drafting is the safest thing it can do with mail — nothing is sent.
connections.googleStillClassesThePermissionAs: Google still classes the permission as restricted, so this stays off unless you ask for it.

specialists.eachOfTheseIsASeparate: Each of these is a separate agent with its own published card. The version and signature below are read from that card, not from this page — so a capability that stops verifying says so here.
specialists.runsInsideTheProductAndPublishes: Runs inside the product and publishes no card — nothing outside can call it.
specialists.notRegisteredInThisDeploymentThis: Not registered in this deployment — this capability is unavailable.

usage.gettingCloseNothingStopsWorkingWit: Getting close. Nothing stops working without telling you first.
usage.usedUpForThisMonthEverything: Used up for this month. Everything else still works.

visual.whatItHasPickedUpAbout: What it has picked up about your visual style, and applies when it makes something for you. Revert any of it and it will stop assuming.
visual.nothingYetAskItToMake: Nothing yet. Ask it to make something and correct the look — that is what it learns from.
